gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).
avoid is followed by -ing: avoid talking.

gaps.sentence: He suggested ___ a taxi instead of walking.
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (no infinitive with a person: suggest that we take is also possible).

gaps.sentence: I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.

gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out tonight.
gaps.explanation: 'Would prefer to do … rather than do'.
